summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. Nasdaq had notified the company on November 10, 2025 of noncompliance for the September 26-November 7, 2025 period, granting an initial 180-day cure window to May 11, 2026, later extended to November 9, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed compliance on September 28, 2026, after Class A Ordinary Shares closed at $1.00 or above for ten consecutive business days from September 14-25, 2026. The matter is closed; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply. Watch for potential renewed bid-price deficiency and future reverse-split risk.
